{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy cannon''' was an energy-base weapon. [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik's]] [[Charon/Legends|Charon]]-constructed body incorporated an energy cannon into its torso. Ship-mounted energy cannons were prevalent during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
